game.title: Sky Stack
game.objective: Stack sliding blocks on top of each other to build a 20-floor tower before the 45-second timer runs out.
game.controls: Tap anywhere on the screen to drop the sliding block onto the top of the tower.
game.core_loop: Wait for the sliding block to align with the tower -> tap to drop -> misaligned edges are sliced off while the tower grows taller and narrower.
game.progression: Each successful drop adds 1 floor toward the 20-floor goal while imperfect drops shrink the remaining block surface, increasing precision difficulty.
game.hook_idea: The 'PERFECT!' drop with golden sparkle burst at t=6.4s, or the rapid-fire slicing and stacking sequence from t=5.4s to t=11.4s.
